# 见好就收：大内第一贪 (Royal Heist: Cash Out)
> 全球首款「朝堂账房搜打撤 × 权财羁绊倍率赌桌」跨端策略游戏。
- Play Online (Free, Zero Login): https://a3152557994-ship-it.github.io/royal-heist/
- Core Loop: Chain Graft/Wild/Consort cards on an imperial abacus -> Survive Buckshot-Roulette Snap Audits via spyglass, scapegoats, or written rhetoric -> Decide whether to extract silver safely down the secret canal before the Old Emperor's life incense burns out!
